name: Tofu Saag
ingredients: 300 g mixed greens (spinach, mustard greens, methi), washed
1 tbsp makki ka atta (maize flour) or besan
steps: Boil the greens with the chilli and ginger for 8 minutes until soft. Drain and blend coarsely.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, then cook the onion and garlic for 6 minutes.
Add the greens, maize flour and ½ cup water and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Add the tofu and simmer for 4 minutes.
Finish with garam masala and salt.
note: Mustard greens are a seasonal Punjabi staple; spinach alone also works.
